info.name: Macrometa API Reference Activity Metrics Waiting rooms API
Get information on all waiting rooms

params.name: pattern
params.description: Fetch waiting room information that matches the pattern. For example, a pattern could be 'aa' or 'test'. To get all waiting room, set the pattern to '*'.

params.name: limit
params.description: The _limit_ parameter determines the number of waiting rooms returned.

params.name: offset
params.description: Represents the starting point from where to begin fetching the waiting room records. This parameter is especially useful in conjunction with the _limit_ parameter for pagination of a large number of waiting room records. By default, it is set to 0, meaning that data retrieval will start from the very first record. For example, if you have 10,000 waiting room records and set the _limit_ to 100, then the first API call without an offset will retrieve records 1 to 100. If you set the _offset_ to 100 for the next call, you will retrieve records 101 to 200, and so on. This way, by incrementing the _offset_ by the _limit_ value for successive calls, you can paginate through the entire dataset.

params.name: order
params.description:
The sort order:
 * _asc_ - Ascending, from A to Z
 * _desc_ - Descending, from Z to A

items.docs: Retrieves a list of waiting rooms that match a specified pattern.
